source_layer: Catalog-defined hypothesis; author webpage/runtime not verified. Existing access failure is retained and is not a generic prerequisite.
authorization_boundary: Assignment permits implementation/prehistory synthetic work; historical run requires exact code/C0 and independent gates below.
instrument: Bitcoin retained; Binance spot BTCUSDT quote/venue is explicit research instance, not original author assertion.
input_period: 2022-12-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; do not change input
evaluation: 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; full24calendar months including initial cash/readiness period. Prior exposed availability-selected window, NOT OOS.
monthly_reporting: Month return=end equity/previous month end equity-1; first denominator100000. Continuous account and indicators, no monthly resetting or selective omission of cash/zero-trade months.

capital.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
capital.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent

execution.at_open: Execute earliest-due pending action if due_index<=currentindex and actual holdings permit. Stale is logged/discarded; no sameopen roundtrip or reentry. No out-of-window fill.
at_close_sequence: Update completed-bar indicators. Compute raw entry and exit independent of holdings.
Raw opposite event cancels pending opposite intent before position gating; if both events arise exit/cancel-buy has priority.
Schedule buy only if flat and raw entry; sell only if long and raw exit.
Same-direction repeat retains original earliest due; absent event does not cancel an existing intent.
All calendar labels refer to UTC bar-open date; signal close knowledge becomes actionable at following bar open or declared lag2.
No warmup intents, equality neutral except explicit previous-side inclusive crossing condition.
execution.lag2: Raw opposite event at t+1 cancels pending intent due t+2. Absence of event retains original intent/due, no repeated deferral.

valuation: Endbar equity=cash+quantity*rawclose. No funding/interest, no dividend assumptions needed for spot BTC. No terminal liquidation or hypothetical exit fee; report residual inventory and pending action separately. No fill outside evaluation.

benchmark.required_existing_control: M1258 buyhold100% fee-inclusive, base8bps+2bps, first2023-01-01dailyopen, mark2024-12-31close, samecanonical48e4/Decimal50/100000USDT/731rows/statistics
benchmark.status_at_freeze: M1258 C0 frozen; actual control not yet validated or remotely delivered. Do not claim it exists.
benchmark.gate_before_history: Wait for root verified M1258 control output hash/publiccore pin and exact identity match. No silently reused95% control, no automatic newcontrol authorization.

precision: Proposed Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN from original decimal CSV strings for indicators and account; recursive update prev+alpha*(x-prev), preserve exact constant input; independent implementation must match seeds/ready mask. Conversion to float only output metrics, no price rounding/tick assumptions.
QA_gate: Recheck exact inputhash/grid/uniqueness/close_time/finite positiveOHLC/nonnegativevolume/trades/OHLC bounds; reject any failure, no imputation/drop/forwardfill. Existing QA accepted input may have low-activity bars; do not silently add volume filter. Halt metadata retained;4h OHLC does not prove continuous executable liquidity.
stop_or_roi: No intrabar stop/ROI added when absent from catalog; gap risk borne by nextopen proxy.
known_halt: Known2023-03-24 halt is intraday; no daily-midnight override. No general tradability claim.

input.reacquire_command_template: In an isolated repository checkout without retained M0216 input.csv: python research/public-strategies/M0216/scripts/rebuild_inputs.py --raw-dir NEW_PRIVATE_RAW_DIRECTORY --staging-dir NEW_PRIVATE_STAGING_DIRECTORY
input.raw_validation: 50 fixed ZIP/CHECKSUM objects,25 provider checksum andZIPCRC; canonical byte rebuild; no current finality or PIT guarantee.

statistics.base_series: 731 raw daily-close equity values including cash days, with initial100000 prepended only for returns/drawdown
statistics.sharpe_zero_cash: mean(r)/sample_std(r,ddof=1)*sqrt(365); null when standard deviation is0
statistics.monthly_return: month final equity/prior month final equity-1; firstdenominator100000; all24calendar months continuous, no reset
statistics.monthly_counts: fills by execution UTC month; days_long=endclose quantity>0; allzero activity months retained
statistics.roundtrip: a buy followed by a sell; netpnl=sale cash_after-entry cash_before; open trade excluded from win_rate
statistics.win_rate: strictly positive netpnl/closedroundtrips; zero included denominator; null if no closedtrade
statistics.exposure: endclose bars quantity>0 divided by731; no intrabar inference
statistics.fee_total: sum exact Decimal fees; represented decimaltext
statistics.floats: Decimal values converted to float64 for numpy metrics only; no float in indicators, order eligibility, allocation, valuation
statistics.serialization: CSV UTF8 csv.writer default CRLF; booleans0/1; missing empty; Decimal str no quantization; JSON indent2 UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False newline; no timestamps in deterministic results

capital_provenance: Catalog position fraction unspecified; fullcash fee-inclusive is explicitly selected hypothesis, not author rule.
cold_start: 31 pre-evaluation daily bars for indicators; start allcash, no warmup intent. First evaluation close may compare prior ready feature; earliest signal-driven fill is second evaluation open.

bollinger.SMA: Current and previous19 closes; sum in chronological order/20, Decimal50.
bollinger.variance: Population ddof0; sum((close-mean)^2) in chronological order/20, then Decimal50.sqrt(); upper=mean+2*sqrt(variance), lower=mean-2*sqrt(variance).
bollinger.convention: Populationvariance and strictcross choices are explicit hypothesis, not verified formal author Trading Rules.

entry: Previousready C<=upper and current C>upper; strict currentupcross, not persistent aboveupper entry.
exit: Previousready C>=middle and current C<middle; strict currentdowncross; exactmiddle equality retains position.
membership_scope: Only printed catalog long20/2breakout andmiddleexit. No membership text, shortside, lowerband meanreversion, parametersearch or authorperformance reproduction.
date_scope: Research2023–2024 subwindow of catalog approx2015–present, chosen by available data; source proposeddate2026-01-25 is preserved. Not OOS.
economic_hypothesis: Volatility-band trend continuation with middle-line exit; inferred research rationale not proven.
